summary.oneLiner: The deck positions M&M as a multi-engine group — market-leading Auto (SUV/LCV) and Farm franchises plus Finance, Tech and "Growth Gems" (Real Estate, Accelo, Logistics, Trucks & Buses, Aerostructures) — delivering "Acceleration in Uncertainty" through commodity inflation via scale, leadership share and an AI-led transformation.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Auto: "#1 in SUV Revenue MS" with SUV revenue market share of 25.0% in Q1 F27 (up 230 bps YoY, 50 bps QoQ) while ranking "#2 in Volume MS" and "#2 in PV Revenue MS".
- LCV: "#1 IN LCV <3.5T" with volume market share of 52.0% in Q1 F27, a gain of 150 bps QoQ.
- Farm: market leadership at 44.9% market share (including Gromax), up 30 bps YoY, with domestic share rising from 42.7% in Q1 F23 to 44.9% in Q1 F27; farm machinery Rotavator "continue to retain No. 2 position in industry".
- EVs: "INDIA'S HIGHEST SELLING ELECTRIC VEHICLE" (as per Q1 FY27 wholesale volume in EV 4W PV category in India) and "#1 in Revenue MS in Q1F27" for E-SUVs; E-SUV Revenue MS shown at 40.6% in Q1 F27.
- Trucks & Buses: market share 7.8% in Q1 F27 and "First time ever No. 2 in ILCV Buses Segment with 26.6% MS"; Last Mile Mobility holds E-3W market leadership at 39.5% MS.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- "Consistent delivery on commitments": RoE (%) trend shown as 13.8 (F19), 0.3 (F20), 4.4 (F21, considering continuing & discontinued operations), 14.8 (F22), 17.7 (F23, including gains on SEL and Susten net of Trucks impairment), 18.4 (F24), 18.1 (F25), 20.1 (F26) and 23.0 for Q1 F27 (annualised basis the quarter ROE).
- Portfolio pruning alongside build-out: Erkunt Foundry exited in Farm, while the investment line was aided by a gain on sale of CIE.
- Capital directed at "Growth Gems" — Real Estate, Accelo and Logistics — described as "Multiple growth engines delivering value in tough times".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Acquisition] "SML acquisition by M&M completed in Q2'26"; Mahindra's Trucks & Buses business now comprises Mahindra Trucks & Buses division (MTBD) and SML Mahindra Limited (SML).
- [AI programme] "AI Acceleration" with the ambition to "Be a Tech leader in every industry" across Deploy / Transform / Invent, organised as Experience.ai, Quality.ai, Reach.ai and Efficiency.ai, with a Group AI governance council and partnerships.
- [AI foundation] 50+ FDEs & AI experts, 19 proprietary AI models, 15+ AI transformation projects and 1900+ trained in the MAI academy; illustrations include Paint.ai at 90.6% First Time Buy off in paint shop PTED, 2.6K workshop staff using AI assistants (85% adoption), 91K+ test drives booked via AI agents, 5L+ customer service requests fulfilled, and drag-coefficient prediction within 2 minutes (from 10+ hours earlier).
- [NBFC metrics — MMFSL, as stated] AUM growth 13%, disbursements 22%, GS3 3.45%, and "NIM expansion … 7.3%, 55bps".
- [IT services — Tech Mahindra, as stated] Large deal wins TCV of $1,078mn (33%), EBIT 14.4% (330bps) and free cash flow of $167mn (94%).
